datasets.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
datasets.description: The Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem provides free and open access to Sentinel satellite data (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, Sentinel-3 ocean/land, Sentinel-5P atmospheric). Supports discovery, visualization, and download of Earth observation data products.
datasets.notes: Free registration required. OAuth2 credentials (client_id/client_secret) must be set as environment variables. Connector implemented for Sentinel-2 L2A data discovery and download.

datasets.name: NASA Earthdata
datasets.description: NASA's Earthdata platform providing access to NASA's Earth science data collections including MODIS, VIIRS, Landsat (via USGS), ICESat-2, GRACE, and more. Supports CMR (Common Metadata Repository) search and data download.
datasets.notes: Free NASA Earthdata account required. Connector implemented for CMR search and data access. Large archive spanning decades of Earth observation data.

datasets.name: USGS Landsat Collection
datasets.description: USGS-hosted Landsat data archive providing the longest continuous satellite record of Earth's surface (Landsat 1-9). Includes surface reflectance, surface temperature, and analysis-ready data products.
datasets.notes: Planned — requires USGS EROS account and M2M API integration. The longest-running satellite land observation program.

datasets.name: Copernicus Marine Service (CMEMS)
datasets.description: Copernicus Marine Environment Monitoring Service providing ocean analysis, forecasts, and reanalysis products. Includes sea surface temperature, salinity, currents, sea level, chlorophyll, and biogeochemical variables.
datasets.notes: Planned — requires Copernicus Marine account. Comprehensive ocean data service with analysis, forecast, and reanalysis products.

datasets.name: NASA PO.DAAC
datasets.description: NASA Physical Oceanography Distributed Active Archive Center. Provides ocean-related satellite data including sea surface temperature, sea surface height, ocean winds, and salinity from missions like Jason, GRACE, Aquarius, and SWOT.
datasets.notes: Planned — uses NASA Earthdata login. Specializes in physical oceanography satellite data products.

datasets.name: Argo Float Network
datasets.description: Global array of ~4000 autonomous profiling floats measuring temperature, salinity, and increasingly biogeochemical parameters in the upper 2000m of the ocean. Provides real-time and delayed-mode quality-controlled data.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Global ocean temperature and salinity profiling network. Real-time data available within 24 hours.

datasets.name: ECMWF Climate Data Store
datasets.description: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts Climate Data Store. Provides access to ERA5 reanalysis, seasonal forecasts, climate projections, and satellite-derived climate data records.
datasets.notes: Planned — requires CDS API key. Primary source for ERA5 reanalysis data. Registration is free but API key must be configured.

datasets.name: NOAA Weather Services
datasets.description: NOAA weather data services providing current conditions, forecasts, alerts, and historical weather observations. Includes the Weather API, METAR/TAF reports, and climate normals.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Primarily covers US territory. For global data, use ECMWF CDS or other international services.

datasets.name: India Meteorological Department
datasets.description: India Meteorological Department data services providing weather observations, forecasts, and climate data for the Indian subcontinent. Includes monsoon monitoring and tropical cyclone data.
datasets.notes: Planned — restricted access. Some datasets require institutional affiliation or data request process. High-resolution gridded rainfall data available for research.

datasets.name: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program
datasets.description: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program providing real-time earthquake notifications, searchable earthquake catalogs, hazard maps, and ShakeMap products. Global coverage with enhanced detail for US territory.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Comprehensive global earthquake catalog. FDSN event web service for programmatic access.

datasets.name: EarthScope FDSN Services
datasets.description: EarthScope (formerly IRIS) FDSN data services providing access to seismic waveform data, station metadata, and event catalogs from global seismographic networks. Supports FDSN web services standard.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Primary source for seismic waveform data. Uses standard FDSN web services accessible via ObsPy.

datasets.name: ERA5 Reanalysis
datasets.description: ERA5 is ECMWF's fifth-generation global atmospheric reanalysis providing hourly data on many atmospheric, land-surface, and sea-state parameters from 1940 to present at 0.25° resolution. The gold standard for atmospheric reanalysis.
datasets.notes: Planned — requires CDS API key (same as ecmwf_cds). ERA5 is accessed through the Climate Data Store. Extremely large dataset — selective variable/region downloads recommended.

datasets.name: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP)
datasets.description: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies Surface Temperature Analysis providing global surface temperature change estimates from 1880 to present. Key dataset for global warming monitoring.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Direct download of global temperature anomaly data. Standard reference dataset for global temperature trends.

datasets.name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
datasets.description: NOAA NCEI (formerly NCDC) hosting one of the world's largest archives of atmospheric, coastal, geophysical, and oceanic data. Includes GHCN, OISST, IBTrACS, and many other climate datasets.
datasets.notes: Most data publicly accessible. Some API endpoints accept an optional token for higher rate limits. Comprehensive climate data archive.

datasets.name: NASA Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO)
datasets.description: Solar Dynamics Observatory providing high-cadence, multi-wavelength solar imagery from AIA (Atmospheric Imaging Assembly) and magnetogram data from HMI (Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager). Primary data source for solar physics research.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible via JSOC (Joint Science Operations Center). Email registration recommended for bulk data exports. Extremely high data volume (~1.5 TB/day).

datasets.name: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
datasets.description: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center providing real-time solar and geomagnetic data, space weather forecasts, alerts, and historical archives. Includes GOES X-ray flux, solar wind data, and geomagnetic indices.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Real-time space weather data and forecasts. Primary source for operational space weather information.

datasets.name: NASA Planetary Data System
datasets.description: NASA's Planetary Data System archiving and distributing scientific data from planetary missions. Includes data from lunar, Mars, outer planets, and small body missions across multiple discipline nodes.
datasets.notes: Planned — publicly accessible but complex archive structure. Distributed across multiple discipline nodes (Geosciences, Atmospheres, Imaging, etc.).

datasets.name: Lunar Data Archives
datasets.description: Collection of lunar data archives including LROC (Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera), Clementine, Apollo, and Chandrayaan mission data. Provides orbital imagery, topography, and compositional data for the Moon.
datasets.notes: Planned — publicly accessible. Primary sources include LROC at ASU and PDS Geosciences Node. Data from multiple lunar missions spanning decades.

datasets.name: Mars Data Archives
datasets.description: Collection of Mars data archives from orbital and surface missions including MRO (HiRISE, CTX, CRISM), Mars Express, Curiosity, and Perseverance. Provides imagery, spectroscopy, and atmospheric data.
datasets.notes: Planned — publicly accessible. Accessed primarily through PDS Geosciences Node Orbital Data Explorer (ODE). Data from multiple Mars missions.

datasets.name: Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST)
datasets.description: NASA's primary archive for UV, optical, and near-infrared space-based astronomy data. Hosts data from Hubble, JWST, TESS, Kepler, GALEX, and other missions. Supports MAST Portal and astroquery programmatic access.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Access via astroquery.mast or direct API. Primary archive for HST, JWST, TESS, and Kepler data.

datasets.name: ESA Gaia Archive
datasets.description: ESA's Gaia mission archive providing the most comprehensive catalog of stellar positions, parallaxes, proper motions, and photometry for nearly 2 billion objects. Supports ADQL queries via TAP interface.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Access via TAP/ADQL queries through astroquery.gaia. Current release: Gaia DR3 with ~1.8 billion sources.

datasets.name: Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS)
datasets.description: Sloan Digital Sky Survey providing imaging and spectroscopic data for millions of galaxies, quasars, and stars. Multi-generation survey (SDSS-I through SDSS-V) with extensive photometric and spectroscopic catalogs.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Access via SkyServer SQL queries, CasJobs, or astroquery.sdss. Covers ~35% of the sky with imaging, ~15% with spectroscopy.

datasets.name: NASA Exoplanet Archive
datasets.description: NASA's primary database for confirmed exoplanets, candidate planets, and stellar properties. Provides comprehensive exoplanet parameters, transit data, radial velocity data, and direct imaging results via TAP interface.
datasets.notes: Publicly accessible — no authentication required. Access via TAP queries or astroquery. Comprehensive catalog of confirmed exoplanets with physical and orbital parameters.
